# Ranjan Sharma (Konsept)

> Portfolio of Ranjan Sharma, an AI and backend developer. LLM-driven products with plain, honest APIs behind them, plus one compiler for fun. Everything listed here is deployed and usable.

## How he works

- AI in front, boring API behind. The model parses, ranks, or summarises; a plain backend does the fetching and never lets the model touch the database directly.
- Ships to a real URL. Every project below is live.
- Rust for the compiler and simulation work, TypeScript for most web backends.

## Projects

Hardest first, as on the site.

- [LyangLang](https://crates.io/crates/lyanglyang): Nepali-keyword programming language in Rust. Tree-walking interpreter and bytecode VM on one AST. Published on crates.io as `lyanglyang`.
- [Clinical Trial Matcher](https://clinicaltrial.ranjansharma.info.np/): Patient notes in, ranked clinical trial matches out, with an estimate of when eligibility may open. LLM parses the notes; a plain API searches the registries.
- [Plant Field Journal](https://plant.ranjansharma.info.np/): Photo in, species guess and care notes out. Identification and guides stream in the browser.
- [Rust Car Sim](https://konseptt.github.io/Rust-Autonomous-Vehicle-Simulation/): Autonomous vehicle simulation in Rust. Pathfinding, obstacle avoidance, egui front end.
- [RetroSudoku](https://sudoku.ranjansharma.info.np/): Sudoku with a DLX solver, human-technique hints, themes, offline PWA.
- [Synapse Research](https://synapse-research.vercel.app): Plain-English PubMed search with an evidence-ranked overview. Fetch, dedupe, and ranking on the server; the model only writes the summary it is handed.
- [Lab Escape](https://lab-escape-beta.vercel.app): Classic psychology paradigms as timed rooms with trial-level logging. Offline-first; logs stay local until you opt in.
- [Hashpass](https://hashpass.ranjansharma.info.np/): Deterministic passwords from a master secret and a site name via Argon2. Nothing stored, nothing synced.
- [Page Fault Simulator](https://page-fault-simulator.vercel.app): Interactive page-replacement visualiser. Frames, faults, algorithm comparison.
- [CPU Scheduler](https://cpu.ranjansharma.info.np/): Scheduling simulator with live Gantt charts and timing metrics for common OS algorithms.
- [SyllabusCal](https://syllabuscal.ranjansharma.info.np/): Syllabus PDF in, calendar `.ics` out. Parsed in memory; no files kept on the server.
- [PrismClause](https://tos.ranjansharma.info.np/): Scan a terms-of-service URL, PDF, or paste and surface the riskiest clauses in plain English.
- [Gap Sheet](https://resume.ranjansharma.info.np/): Compare a job posting to a resume and list skill gaps plus wording fixes.
- [Interview Forecaster](https://interview.ranjansharma.info.np/): From a job description: likely questions, answer frames, red flags. Optional streaming.
- [The Faculty Ledger](https://faculty.ranjansharma.info.np/): Look up professors, compare sections, read ratings before registering.
